services.title: Custom Pool & Spa Construction
services.short_description: Custom concrete and gunite pools, integrated spas, and complete backyard designs built for Pennsylvania's freeze-thaw climate.
services.long_description: Gunite pool construction is the specialty because it holds up to Pennsylvania weather. Spray-applied concrete creates the strongest shell available, and it lets the pool take any shape a lot demands — curving around mature oaks, fitting narrow Back Mountain lots, or stepping down a slope. Every build starts with excavation planned around local soil conditions, from the rocky ledge near Bear Creek to Back Mountain clay. Infinity edges, sun ledges, benches, grottos, acrylic walls, water features, and integrated spas are all in scope.

services.title: Pool Renovation & Remodeling
services.short_description: Replastering, tile, coping, and full concrete pool renovations that make an aging pool look new without a rebuild.
services.long_description: Faded, stained, or cracked plaster and chipped waterline tile are what a Pennsylvania winter does to a pool over ten to fifteen years. Renovation work covers plastering, tile, coping, sandblasting, patio and deck surfaces, depth changes, added spas and water features, benches and tanning ledges, travertine paver installs, and colour-changing lighting. Plaster options carry lifetime warranties and can be brought back to new colour without the demolition most pool plaster requires.
sub_services: Add a Spa or Water Feature

services.title: Pool Repair Service
services.short_description: Resurfacing, replastering, tile and coping repair, and electronic leak detection — including emergency repair when a pool fails mid-season.
services.long_description: Pool problems never happen at a convenient time, so emergency repair is part of the service. Resurfacing and replastering restore a smooth finish and stop small leaks after freeze-thaw has cracked plaster. Coping repair addresses the stone and concrete at the pool's edge before water gets behind the shell. Leak detection uses electronic listening equipment and pressure testing to find failures in the shell, plumbing lines, and equipment — most of them at pipe joints or where plumbing enters the pool.

services.title: Pool Cleaning & Maintenance
services.short_description: Weekly maintenance, seasonal openings and closings, chemical balancing, and water testing across Luzerne and Lackawanna counties.
services.long_description: Openings start in April depending on weather — covers off and stored, equipment restarted, chemistry balanced, swim-ready inside a week. Closings drain lines below frost level, add antifreeze where needed, and install winter covers, which is what prevents an expensive freeze failure. In between: weekly maintenance, chemical balancing tuned to local water, professional water testing for bacteria, metals, and chemical levels, and inspection and safety audits for homeowners buying or selling a house with a pool.

services.title: Masonry & Outdoor Living
services.short_description: Stonework, waterfalls, pavers, retaining walls, fire pits, pool decks, and outdoor kitchens — built by the same crew that builds the pool.
services.long_description: Masonry is half the name for a reason. Stone walls and retaining structures, coping, pool decks, pavers, fire pits, waterfalls, and complete outdoor kitchens are done in-house rather than subcontracted, which is why the hardscape and the pool actually meet the way the design drawing said they would. Custom rockwork, deck jets, rain arcs, and LED lighting extend the same work into the finished backyard.
